styles.h1: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #333; font-size: 2em; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;
styles.h2: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #444; font-size: 1.5em; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;
styles.h3: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #555; font-size: 1.17em; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;
styles.h4: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #555; font-size: 1em; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;
styles.h5: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #555; font-size: 0.83em; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;
styles.h6: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #555; font-size: 0.75em; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em;
styles.p: font-family: verdana, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; margin-bottom: 1em;
styles.code: font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; background-color: #f4f4f4; padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.9em;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #ccc; padding: 10px 15px; color: #666; margin: 1em 0; font-family: verdana, sans-serif;
styles.table: border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 1em 0; font-family: verdana, sans-serif;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px 12px; background-color: #f2f2f2; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; color: #333;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 1em 0;
styles.ul: padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #333;
styles.ol: padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 1em; font-family: verdana, sans-serif; color: #333;

code_block_wrapper: {content}
